newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady or firmer bar easier gasoline.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady or firmer bar easier gasoline.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady or firmer except for easier gas oil on Monday, traders said.

Gasoline was steady to firmer. The European market was supported by Friday's sharp US product gains ahead of the long holiday weekend. Naphtha was steady to slightly lower. Cargoes were talked weaker at $218/$223 cif NWE.
High sulphur fuel oil was steady to firmer. High sulphur barges traded between $98 and $100 fob ARA.
Gas oil was $1 or so touch weaker as IPE futures eased and premiums held steady.
